name: Hyundai Kona N DCT
notes: Calibrated from KONA N DCT CAN capture 2026-06-04. Uses 0x366 for RPM/speed, 0x453 for intake temp, 0x368 for DCT gear. 1.0.6: FuelLevel corrected to the full 16-bit 0x50C D3:D4 sender counts — the 1.0.5 D3-only liters read wraps mod 256 (108% at a full tank, 0%/255 mid-drain). 1.0.5 (published from main) added BatteryVoltage + TPMS. 1.0.7: power/torque enabled - EMS16 TQI (0x260 D1) x0.390625 with referenceTorqueNm 500 (TQ_STND, constant on 0x329 mux 3) and staticFrictionTorquePct 6.5 (no TQFR on this gateway). 1.0.8: rpm-dependent frictionTorqueCurve added (measured live TQFR 4.7%@2750 to 11.7%@5700 on the 2026-08-02 VN MT WOT capture, same G4KH engine; 6800 rpm tail point extrapolated) - flat 6.5% overstated top-end power by ~5%. staticFrictionTorquePct kept as fallback for older apps. powerGaugeMaxHp 360.

signals.name: CurrentGear
signals.description: DCT gear position from CAN 0x368 byte[4] low nibble (0=P/N, 1-3=Forward, 14=Reverse).
